questions.question: Which early suggestion about the remote's button layout was brought up again during the interface design, and how did the later speaker describe it?
What was the early selling price target, and where did the team refer back to that target when discussing costs?
Who first suggested a way to make the remote easier to hold, and how was that idea represented in a later design discussion?
What did the team propose for the remote's shape before prototyping, and which aspect persisted in the prototype discussion?
What follow-up work did the team assign for researching the target users, and what evidence did a later meeting give that the work was done?
How did the number or grouping of proposed controls change between the early interface discussion and the later prototype review?
Which choice about powering the remote was discussed early, and what constraint did the team mention when returning to that choice later?
What user feedback was first reported in the available meetings, and which part did the team refer back to in a later design discussion?
How did the planned use of colour change from the early design meeting to the latest meeting available for this team?
What price or production budget was set early, and what did the team report about meeting it when reviewing the design?
Who proposed creating a mock-up or prototype, and what did a later discussion show about the work that was delivered?
What early scheduling commitment did the team make about the project reviews, and how did a later meeting report or revise that commitment?
